page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable blocks of review rules. Attach them to any agent — the order you attach them is the order they appear in the prompt.
page.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents using it lose it. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit its body, its context and its evals.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable block of review rules that any agent can attach.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Reject .then() chains in new code; require async/await.
fields.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — what an agent reads to decide the rule applies. Write it as an instruction, not a summary: "Reject X", not "About X".
fields.bodyHint: Goes into the agent's prompt verbatim, under "Skills / rules".

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

stats.title: Agents with this skill attached · how often it reached a prompt · accept rate of findings from those runs

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.emptyBody: This skill has no body yet. Add one in the Config tab.

import.chooseFile: Choose a .md file or a .zip archive
import.previewHint: Check the body before you store it. A skill you import is somebody else's instructions inside your agent's prompt, so it lands disabled until you enable it.
import.ignoredHint: Only the markdown core is imported. These entries were listed and left alone — never unpacked, never executed.
import.unsupported: Only .md files and .zip archives can be imported.
import.descriptionRequired: Add a description — it is what tells an agent when this rule applies.

editor.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: What an agent reads to decide the rule applies. Write it as an instruction — “Reject X”, not “About X”.
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Editing the body is the entire skill — everything else is metadata.
config.unsavedTitle: The body below differs from the saved version. Save to snapshot it.
config.tokensTitle: Estimated from the character count (about 4 characters per token) — there is no tokenizer in the browser. The exact count for a run appears in its trace.
config.messageHint: Stored on the version this save creates, so the history reads as a changelog.
config.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
config.deleteBody: Removes it from all agents. This can't be undone.

evals.runDisabledTitle: The eval pipeline is not wired up yet — a skill cannot be scored until eval sets exist.

empty.title: Evals arrive in a later lesson
empty.body: Once eval sets exist, this tab scores the skill against them and shows whether a body change helped or hurt.

context.title: Project context to use
context.hint: Any agent using this skill inherits these documents.

empty.title: No context attached
empty.body: Attach a spec, a style guide or an ADR and every agent running this skill reads it alongside the rule.

noRepo.title: No repository selected
noRepo.body: Context documents live in a repository. Pick one from the switcher above to see what this skill can carry.

noDocs.title: No context documents in this repo
noDocs.body: Add markdown under specs/, docs/ or insights/ and it shows up here, ready to attach.

stats.caveat: Pull frequency, accept rate and findings are measured over the runs where this skill was present. They say the skill was in the prompt when a finding appeared — not that it caused one. Read them as correlation, not attribution.

empty.title: No runs with this skill yet
empty.body: Attach it to an agent and review a pull request — the figures fill in from the runs that included it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? It is appended as a new version — nothing in the history is rewritten or lost.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

empty.title: Only one version so far
empty.body: Editing the body in the Config tab appends a snapshot here.
